provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: pivot search of rank_exclusion.py over the 36,720 four-qubit stabilizer states (design note, 2026-09-20), then exact refit by fit_coeffs.fit

notes: |CS>^2 = (1/2)|0000> - ((1+i)/2)|+i>^4 - ((1-i)/2)(CZ (x) CZ)|-i>^4, with |+i> = (|0> + i|1>)/sqrt 2 and |-i> its conjugate; the coefficients are in Q(i) and the identity is checked symbolically by the verifier. Found by the design note's pivot search over the 36,720 four-qubit states. There are 16 rank-3 decompositions of |CS>^2 in all, each one computational basis state plus two full-support states, and they form one orbit under the unitary symmetry group of |CS>^2 (the 24 two-qubit Cliffords fixing |CS> up to phase on each copy and the swap of the copies, order 1152), reached by the pivot search from three pivot orbits; this is the member with the basis state |0000>. With the exact rank-2 exclusion of cert_cs_m2_rank2.py this settles chi(|CS>^2) = 3, strictly below the product bound 4, so the transversal-number bound 2^tau for hypergraph states is not tight even for two disjoint edges of size two. Implied gamma log_2(3)/2 = 0.7925 against the single-copy product baseline 1; no exponent has been published for the orbit, so the site does not count the baseline as beaten. The extent exponent 0.678 is the comparison line for the approximate rank.
